reviewScope: Frozen candidate and source binding, valid paid matched comparison, campaign cost reconciliation and archives, and the fail-closed missing-ledger fix. The independent reviewer also audited the post-proof privacy scan, checksum manifest, and synchronized Markdown copy.

focusedTests.note: Primary offline run on tooling commit 998e2381; reviewer did not rerun tests. Paid credentials were removed from the test process; no provider calls were made during review.

paidComparison.candidateQuality: 18/18 fact slots, 15/15 answerable turns, 13/13 context turns, 4/4 safe handoffs; zero unsupported claims and false refusals.

evidenceAudit.imageGate: Three genuine photos; category matched 2/3, visible color matched 3/3, catalog identity was not scored, and 1/15 required visual case types is represented. Product QA FAIL.
evidenceAudit.integration: Proof records PostgreSQL, Redis, message worker, webhook pipeline, product search, fake Meta transport, backend regression, Playwright, and security checks as PASS. This review did not rerun them.
evidenceAudit.originalVerifierPrivacyStep: FAIL; receipt is preserved unchanged. The recorded verifier run found heuristic contact-pattern matches in temporary Jest cache filenames. The later clean-root scan passed, but predates the regenerated proof and is not the final package scan.

finalPackageAudit.note: The proof was regenerated to include this independent package audit. A post-regeneration scan and manifest recomputation follow.

cost.roundingNote: Summing call-level estimates differs from ledger summaries by about 0.000000029 USD due to floating-point aggregation.

limitations: Product QA remains FAIL and integration readiness remains NO because only 1/15 required visual case types is represented and catalog identity was not scored.
Twelve standalone raster artifacts are not OCR-scanned.
Campaign roots entirely absent from workspace inventory cannot be detected automatically; a missing ledger inside a discovered campaign directory marks reconciliation incomplete.
Provider costs are estimates, not invoices, and the shared 10 USD authorization is manually reconciled rather than enforced as one global cap.
No live Meta delivery, production behavior, merchant adoption, conversion, or ROI was established.
